referents.why: you, second masculine singular, addressed in direct speech to the LORD of verse 1
your rod, second masculine singular, the same addressee as you are with me
your staff, second masculine singular, the same addressee
they, third masculine plural, refers to the composite rod and staff; masculine plural wins over the feminine staff, and no other masculine plural candidate is present
referents.category: pronoun for a composite of two objects

referents.why: I will go, first common singular in the psalm's voice
I will fear, first common singular in the psalm's voice

links.why: The builder's conceded link is the even-though concession gam ki: the fear holds though the walk is through the valley of death.
Mid-verse ki after the claim gives its reason: I will fear no evil because you are with me.

groups.why: Gam ki concession: the valley is the obstacle, no fear is the claim that holds anyway, you are with me is its ground. The two builder links are its parts.

none_fit.what: a verbless topic (your rod and your staff) followed by its comment (they comfort me); no link type for topic and comment

cant_tell.what: whether the shift to you in verse 4 is a speech addressed to the LORD (a turn) or the same voice's direct address
cant_tell.why: the form marks no speech frame; the psalm's writing group already holds the voice
